recipes.name: Mămăligă cu Brânză și Ou
recipes.description: Creamy Romanian polenta topped with crumbled telemea, a fried egg and a spoonful of sour cream.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil with the salt in a heavy pot.
Pour in the cornmeal in a thin stream while whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Reduce the heat and cook for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring often, until thick and pulling away from the sides.
Melt the butter in a pan and fry the eggs sunny-side up until the whites are set.
Spoon the mămăligă onto plates, crumble the telemea on top and add the fried egg.
Finish with a dollop of sour cream and freshly ground black pepper.

recipes.name: Ouă Ochiuri Românești
recipes.description: Soft water-poached eggs with runny yolks, served the Romanian way with butter, telemea and fresh bread.
instructions: Fill a wide pan with water, add the vinegar and a pinch of salt, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Crack each egg into a small cup and slide it carefully into the barely simmering water.
Poach for 3 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still soft.
Lift the eggs out with a slotted spoon and drain briefly on a paper towel.
Place on warm plates, top each egg with a sliver of butter and season with pepper.
Serve with slices of telemea, fresh bread and green onions.

recipes.name: Papară
recipes.description: Thrifty Romanian scramble of torn bread fried golden in butter, bound with eggs and finished with cheese.
instructions: Tear the bread into bite-sized pieces.
Melt the butter in a large pan and fry the bread over medium heat until golden and slightly crisp.
Beat the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper.
Pour the eggs over the bread and stir gently until just set.
Crumble the telemea on top, take off the heat and let it soften for a minute.
Serve hot with chopped green onions.

recipes.name: Clătite cu Gem
recipes.description: Thin, lacy Romanian crepes rolled around fruit jam and dusted with powdered sugar.
instructions: Whisk the eggs with the sugar, vanilla sugar and a pinch of salt.
Add the milk and sparkling water, then whisk in the flour until the batter is smooth and thin.
Stir in the melted butter and let the batter rest for 15 minutes.
Heat a lightly oiled non-stick pan and pour in a small ladle of batter, swirling to coat the base.
Cook for about 1 minute per side until golden, then stack the crepes on a plate.
Spread each crepe with jam, roll up and dust with powdered sugar before serving.

recipes.name: Clătite cu Brânză Dulce la Cuptor
recipes.description: Crepes filled with sweet vanilla cottage cheese and raisins, baked under a sour cream glaze until golden.
instructions: Whisk the eggs, milk, flour and a pinch of salt into a thin batter and cook 8 crepes in a lightly oiled pan.
Mix the cottage cheese with the sugar, vanilla extract, lemon zest, raisins and one egg yolk.
Place a spoonful of filling on each crepe and roll it up, tucking in the sides.
Arrange the rolls snugly in a buttered baking dish.
Whisk the sour cream with a tablespoon of sugar and spread it over the crepes.
Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes until lightly golden on top and serve warm.

recipes.name: Plăcintă cu Brânză Sărată
recipes.description: Flaky phyllo pie layered with salty telemea, eggs and dill, baked until crisp and golden.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and brush a rectangular baking dish with melted butter.
Crumble the telemea and mix it with the cottage cheese, 3 eggs, chopped dill and pepper.
Layer half the phyllo sheets in the dish, brushing every second sheet with melted butter.
Spread the cheese filling evenly, then cover with the remaining sheets, buttering as you go.
Whisk the last egg with the yogurt and pour it over the top, letting it soak in.
Score into squares and bake for 40 minutes until deep golden. Cool slightly before cutting.

recipes.name: Plăcintă cu Mere
recipes.description: Crisp phyllo apple pie with grated apples, cinnamon and semolina, perfect warm with morning coffee.
instructions: Peel and coarsely grate the apples, then squeeze out the excess juice.
Cook the apples with the sugar and cinnamon in a pan for 8 minutes until softened. Stir in the semolina and cool.
Preheat the oven to 180°C and butter a baking dish.
Layer half the phyllo sheets in the dish, brushing each with melted butter.
Spread the apple filling evenly and cover with the remaining buttered sheets.
Bake for 35 minutes until golden, cool for 10 minutes and dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Griș cu Lapte
recipes.description: Silky warm semolina pudding simmered in vanilla milk and swirled with fruit jam.
instructions: Bring the milk to a simmer with the sugar, vanilla sugar and a pinch of salt.
Pour the semolina in a thin stream while whisking constantly.
Cook over low heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Take off the heat and stir in the butter.
Spoon into bowls and top each with a swirl of jam and a dusting of cinnamon.

recipes.name: Orez cu Lapte
recipes.description: Comforting Romanian rice pudding cooked slowly in milk with lemon zest and a cinnamon dusting.
instructions: Rinse the rice and simmer it in the water for 10 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Add the milk, sugar, lemon zest and a pinch of salt and bring back to a gentle simmer.
Cook uncovered over low heat for 25 minutes, stirring often, until creamy.
Stir in the vanilla sugar and butter and take off the heat.
Serve warm or chilled, dusted with cinnamon and topped with jam.

recipes.name: Papanași
recipes.description: Golden fried cottage cheese doughnuts, piled with sour cream and sour cherry jam.
instructions: Mix the cottage cheese with the egg, sugar, vanilla sugar, lemon zest and a pinch of salt.
Work in the flour and baking soda to get a soft dough that is just firm enough to shape.
With floured hands form 4 rings and 4 small balls from the dough.
Heat the oil to 170°C and fry the rings and balls in batches for 3 to 4 minutes per side until deep golden.
Drain on paper towels.
Stack each ring with a ball on top, spoon over sour cream and finish with jam.

recipes.name: Scrob cu Slănină Afumată
recipes.description: Country-style scrambled eggs cooked in the rendered fat of crispy smoked bacon, with green onions.
instructions: Dice the smoked bacon and fry it in a dry pan over medium heat until crisp and the fat has rendered.
Add the sliced green onions and cook for 1 minute.
Beat the eggs with a splash of milk, salt and pepper.
Pour the eggs into the pan and stir slowly with a spatula until soft curds form.
Remove from the heat while still slightly glossy and serve with bread and tomato wedges.

recipes.name: Bulz cu Brânză la Cuptor
recipes.description: Shepherd's polenta balls hiding a molten telemea centre, baked with butter and crisp smoked bacon.
instructions: Cook the cornmeal in salted boiling water for 20 minutes, stirring, until very thick. Cool until handleable.
Mix the telemea with the butter and half the sour cream into a soft paste.
With wet hands flatten a portion of polenta, place a spoonful of cheese in the middle and shape into a ball.
Arrange the balls in a buttered dish and scatter the diced smoked bacon around them.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden on top.
Serve hot with the remaining sour cream and a fried egg if you like.

recipes.name: Budincă de Pâine cu Mere
recipes.description: Stale bread turned into a custardy baked pudding with apples, raisins and cinnamon.
instructions: Cut the bread into cubes and spread them in a buttered baking dish.
Peel and dice the apples and scatter them with the raisins over the bread.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, sugar, vanilla extract and cinnamon.
Pour the custard over the bread and press down gently so everything soaks. Rest for 15 minutes.
Dot with butter and bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until puffed and golden.
Serve warm, dusted with powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Brânzoaice (Poale-n Brâu)
recipes.description: Soft yeasted Moldavian buns folded around a sweet cottage cheese and raisin filling.
instructions: Dissolve the yeast and a teaspoon of sugar in the warm milk and let it foam for 10 minutes.
Mix the flour, remaining sugar, 2 eggs, melted butter and salt with the yeast milk into a soft dough. Knead 10 minutes.
Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled.
Mix the cottage cheese with 1 egg, sugar, vanilla sugar, lemon zest and raisins.
Roll the dough and cut into 12 squares. Put filling in the centre and fold the corners to the middle.
Brush with beaten egg and bake at 180°C for 25 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Platou de Mic Dejun Românesc
recipes.description: No-cook country platter of telemea, tomatoes, cucumber, green onions, olives, ham and fresh bread.
instructions: Cut the telemea and cascaval into thick slices and arrange on a large board.
Slice the tomatoes and cucumber into wedges and add them alongside.
Trim the green onions and fold the ham slices beside the cheese.
Add a small bowl of olives and spoon the zacuscă into another.
Slice the bread and serve everything with butter, salt and pepper on the side.

recipes.name: Syrniki Cottage Cheese Pancakes
recipes.description: Thick, tender Eastern European cottage cheese pancakes, fried golden and served with sour cream and jam.
instructions: Press the cottage cheese through a sieve for a smooth texture.
Mix it with the egg, sugar, vanilla extract and a pinch of salt.
Add the flour and stir until a soft, slightly sticky dough forms.
Shape into 8 thick patties and dredge lightly in extra flour.
Fry in butter over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Serve warm with sour cream and jam.

recipes.name: Buckwheat Porridge with Milk
recipes.description: Nutty toasted buckwheat simmered until tender, served warm with milk, butter and honey.
instructions: Toast the buckwheat groats in a dry pan for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the water and salt, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Take off the heat and let it steam, covered, for 5 minutes.
Stir in the butter.
Spoon into bowls, pour over warm milk and drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce with cumin and paprika, served with crusty bread.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wide pan and soften the diced onion and bell pepper for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and chili flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Make 4 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks still soft.
Scatter with parsley and crumbled feta and serve straight from the pan with bread.

recipes.name: Green Shakshuka
recipes.description: A fresh twist on shakshuka: eggs baked into wilted spinach, leek and herbs with creamy feta.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan and cook the sliced leek and garlic for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the spinach in handfuls and stir until wilted, then season with salt, pepper and cumin.
Stir in the chopped dill and parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Make 4 wells in the greens and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 minutes until the whites are set.
Crumble the feta on top and serve with yogurt and warm pita.

recipes.name: Spinach and Feta Frittata
recipes.description: Fluffy oven-finished frittata packed with spinach, red onion, feta and fresh dill.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C.
Heat the olive oil in an ovenproof pan and soften the sliced red onion for 4 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook until wilted, then spread it evenly in the pan.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, dill, salt and pepper and pour over the vegetables.
Crumble the feta on top and cook on the stove for 3 minutes until the edges set.
Transfer to the oven for 12 minutes until puffed and just set in the centre. Slice into wedges.

recipes.name: Potato and Chorizo Frittata
recipes.description: Spanish-style frittata with crisp-edged potatoes, smoky chorizo and sweet onion, baked until golden.
instructions: Peel the potatoes, cut into 1 cm cubes and boil in salted water for 8 minutes. Drain well.
Fry the diced chorizo in an ovenproof pan for 3 minutes until the oil runs red, then add the sliced onion and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and fry until lightly browned.
Whisk the eggs with the smoked paprika, parsley, salt and pepper and pour over the pan.
Cook on low for 5 minutes until the edges set, then bake at 190°C for 12 minutes.
Cool slightly, slice into wedges and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Baked Eggs in Avocado
recipes.description: Halved avocados baked with an egg nestled inside, finished with crispy bacon bits and chives.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Halve the avocados, remove the stones and scoop out a little flesh to make room for the eggs.
Set the halves in a small baking dish so they sit level.
Crack an egg into each half, season with salt, pepper and chili flakes.
Bake for 15 minutes until the whites are set.
Meanwhile fry the bacon until crisp, crumble it over the eggs and scatter with chives.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Scrambled Eggs
recipes.description: Slow-cooked creamy scrambled eggs folded with smoked salmon and chives, served on buttered toast.
instructions: Whisk the eggs with the cream, a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over low heat and pour in the eggs.
Stir slowly and constantly with a spatula until soft, glossy curds form, about 5 minutes.
Tear the smoked salmon into pieces and fold it in with the chives just before the eggs finish.
Toast and butter the bread and pile the eggs on top. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Menemen
recipes.description: Turkish soft scrambled eggs cooked into sweet green peppers and juicy tomatoes with a hint of chili.
instructions: Heat the olive oil and butter in a pan and cook the diced green peppers for 5 minutes.
Grate the tomatoes and add them with the chili flakes, salt and pepper. Simmer 8 minutes until jammy.
Lightly beat the eggs and pour them into the pan.
Stir gently over low heat until the eggs are just set but still creamy.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve immediately with warm bread.

recipes.name: Huevos Rancheros
recipes.description: Crisp tortillas topped with black beans, fried eggs, a quick spicy tomato salsa, avocado and coriander.
instructions: Make the salsa: soften the onion and garlic in a little oil, add the crushed tomatoes, chili, cumin and salt and simmer 10 minutes.
Warm the drained beans in a small pan with a pinch of cumin, mashing lightly.
Fry the tortillas in a little oil for 1 minute per side until lightly crisp.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up.
Spread beans over each tortilla, add an egg and spoon over the salsa.
Top with sliced avocado, coriander and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Garlic Mushroom Scramble on Toast
recipes.description: Buttery garlic and thyme mushrooms folded into soft scrambled eggs, piled onto toasted sourdough-style bread.
instructions: Slice the mushrooms and fry them in half the butter over high heat until golden, about 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and thyme leaves, season and cook 1 minute more. Set aside.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper.
Melt the remaining butter in the pan over low heat and scramble the eggs slowly until softly set.
Fold the mushrooms back in.
Toast the bread, spoon over the scramble and finish with grated parmesan and parsley.

recipes.name: Honey and Walnut Porridge
recipes.description: Creamy stovetop oat porridge finished with toasted walnuts, a drizzle of honey and sliced banana.
instructions: Combine the oats, milk, water and salt in a saucepan.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Meanwhile toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes and roughly chop.
Stir the cinnamon into the porridge and divide between bowls.
Top with sliced banana, walnuts and a generous drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Berry and Chia Overnight Oats
recipes.description: No-cook jar of oats, chia and yogurt soaked overnight, layered with juicy mixed berries.
instructions: Stir together the oats, chia seeds, milk, yogurt, honey and vanilla extract in a bowl.
Divide between two jars, cover and refrigerate overnight (at least 6 hours).
In the morning stir and loosen with a splash of milk if too thick.
Top with the berries and a sprinkle of almonds.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Thick, satisfying overnight oats with mashed banana, peanut butter and dark chocolate shavings.
instructions: Mash the banana in a bowl and whisk in the peanut butter, milk, yogurt and maple syrup.
Stir in the oats, chia seeds and a pinch of salt.
Spoon into a jar, cover and refrigerate overnight.
Serve topped with grated dark chocolate and a few extra banana slices.

recipes.name: Blueberry Baked Oatmeal
recipes.description: A sliceable tray of baked oats with bursting blueberries, cinnamon and maple syrup, great for meal prep.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and butter a 20 cm baking dish.
Mix the oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt in a bowl.
Whisk the eggs, milk, maple syrup, melted butter and vanilla extract in another bowl.
Combine wet and dry, fold in most of the blueberries and pour into the dish.
Scatter the remaining blueberries and the almonds on top.
Bake for 35 minutes until set and golden. Serve warm with yogurt.

recipes.name: Savoury Oat Porridge with Egg and Parmesan
recipes.description: Oats cooked risotto-style in broth with parmesan and butter, topped with a fried egg and green onions.
instructions: Melt the butter in a saucepan and toast the oats for 1 minute.
Add the broth and simmer for 6 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Stir in the grated parmesan and season with pepper.
Fry the eggs in olive oil until the edges are crisp and the yolks runny.
Spoon the porridge into bowls, top with the eggs, sliced green onions and chili flakes.

recipes.name: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
recipes.description: Tall, tender American-style pancakes with a buttermilk tang, stacked with butter and maple syrup.
instructions: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
In a jug whisk the buttermilk, eggs, melted butter and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet into the dry and stir until just combined; a few lumps are fine. Rest 5 minutes.
Heat a lightly buttered pan over medium heat and ladle in 80 ml of batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form and pop on the surface, about 2 minutes, then flip and cook 1 minute more.
Serve stacked with butter and maple syrup.

recipes.name: Belgian Waffles
recipes.description: Crisp, deep-pocketed waffles made light with whipped egg whites, topped with strawberries and cream.
instructions: Separate the eggs. Whisk the yolks with the milk, melted butter and vanilla extract.
Stir in the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt until smooth.
Beat the egg whites to soft peaks and fold them gently into the batter.
Preheat and lightly grease the waffle iron.
Cook each waffle for 4 to 5 minutes until golden and crisp.
Serve warm with sliced strawberries, whipped cream and a dusting of powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Cinnamon French Toast
recipes.description: Thick bread slices soaked in vanilla-cinnamon custard and fried in butter until caramelised and golden.
instructions: Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon and vanilla extract in a shallow dish.
Dip each slice of bread in the custard for 20 seconds per side.
Melt some butter in a large pan over medium heat.
Fry the slices for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Serve warm with maple syrup and fresh berries.

recipes.name: Savoury French Toast with Ham and Cheese
recipes.description: Egg-soaked bread sandwiches with ham and melted cascaval, fried crisp and served with tomatoes.
instructions: Whisk the eggs with the milk, mustard, salt and pepper in a shallow dish.
Make 2 sandwiches with the bread, ham and sliced cascaval.
Dip each sandwich in the egg mixture, letting both sides soak for 20 seconds.
Fry in butter over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut in half and serve with sliced tomatoes and chives.

recipes.name: Breakfast Burrito
recipes.description: Warm tortillas rolled around scrambled eggs, crispy potatoes, bacon, cheese and salsa-style tomatoes.
instructions: Dice the potatoes small and fry in oil for 12 minutes until crisp and golden. Season with paprika and salt.
Fry the bacon until crisp, then chop.
Scramble the eggs in butter until just set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill each tortilla with eggs, potatoes, bacon, grated cheese, diced tomato and a dash of hot sauce.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Toast the burritos seam-side down for 1 minute to seal.

recipes.name: Bacon, Egg and Cheese Breakfast Sandwich
recipes.description: Toasted bun with crispy bacon, a fried egg with a jammy yolk and melted cheddar — a diner classic.
instructions: Fry the bacon in a pan until crisp and set aside on paper towels.
Split and toast the buns in the bacon fat until golden.
Fry the eggs in butter, breaking the yolks lightly if you prefer them set, and lay a slice of cheese on each to melt.
Spread the bun bases with mayonnaise and ketchup.
Stack the bacon, cheesy egg and a few arugula leaves, close the sandwich and serve hot.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
recipes.description: Smashed lemony avocado on toasted whole wheat bread, crowned with a poached egg and chili flakes.
instructions: Bring a pan of water to a gentle simmer with the vinegar.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Toast the bread and spread thickly with the avocado.
Crack each egg into a cup, slide into the water and poach for 3 minutes.
Lift out, drain and place on the toast.
Finish with chili flakes, a drizzle of olive oil and cherry tomato halves.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Bagel
recipes.description: Toasted bagel with dill cream cheese, silky smoked salmon, red onion, capers and cucumber ribbons.
instructions: Mix the cream cheese with chopped dill, lemon zest and a little black pepper.
Split and toast the bagels.
Spread both halves generously with the dill cream cheese.
Layer on the smoked salmon, thin red onion rings and cucumber ribbons.
Scatter with capers, squeeze over lemon juice and close or serve open-faced.

recipes.name: Croque Monsieur
recipes.description: Parisian café classic: ham and gruyère sandwich under a blanket of nutmeg béchamel, grilled until bubbling.
instructions: Melt 20 g butter, stir in the flour and cook 1 minute. Whisk in the milk gradually and simmer until thick. Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Lightly toast the bread and spread one side of each slice with mustard.
Layer ham and half the grated cheese on 2 slices and close with the other 2 slices.
Spread the béchamel over the tops and sprinkle with the remaining cheese.
Grill under a hot oven grill for 5 to 7 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Serve hot with a few salad leaves.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Bowl with Figs and Pistachios
recipes.description: Thick Greek yogurt with fresh figs, crushed pistachios, honey and a hint of cinnamon — no cooking needed.
instructions: Spoon the yogurt into two bowls and smooth the surface.
Quarter the figs and arrange them on top.
Roughly crush the pistachios and scatter over the figs.
Drizzle generously with honey and dust with cinnamon.
Add a sprinkle of granola for crunch and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Berry Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: Thick blended frozen berries and banana topped with granola, fresh fruit, coconut and chia seeds.
instructions: Blend the frozen berries, frozen banana, yogurt and a splash of milk until thick and smooth, scraping down as needed.
Spoon the mixture into a bowl.
Arrange the sliced strawberries and kiwi on top.
Sprinkle with granola, desiccated coconut and chia seeds.
Drizzle with honey and eat right away.

recipes.name: Mango Coconut Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: Tropical dairy-free bowl of blended mango, banana and coconut milk, topped with toasted coconut and lime.
instructions: Peel and dice the mango and freeze for at least 2 hours, or use pre-frozen.
Blend the frozen mango, banana, coconut milk and lime juice until thick and creamy.
Toast the desiccated coconut in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden.
Pour the smoothie into a bowl and top with toasted coconut, pumpkin seeds and extra mango.
Finish with a drizzle of agave syrup and mint leaves.

recipes.name: Homemade Honey Nut Granola
recipes.description: Crunchy oven-baked clusters of oats, almonds, walnuts and seeds glazed with honey and cinnamon.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°C and line a tray with baking paper.
Mix the oats, chopped almonds and walnuts, sunflower seeds, cinnamon and salt in a large bowl.
Warm the honey, coconut oil and vanilla extract together until liquid and pour over the oats. Stir to coat.
Spread evenly on the tray and bake for 25 minutes, stirring once halfway, until golden.
Cool completely on the tray so clusters form, then stir in the dried cranberries.
Store in an airtight jar for up to 2 weeks and serve with yogurt or milk.

recipes.name: Blueberry Muffins
recipes.description: Bakery-style domed muffins bursting with blueberries and a crunchy sugar top.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a 12-hole muffin tin with paper cases.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
In a jug whisk the eggs, milk, melted butter and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet into the dry and stir briefly until just combined, then fold in the blueberries.
Divide between the cases, sprinkle the tops with brown sugar.
Bake for 20 to 22 minutes until risen and golden. Cool 5 minutes before eating.

recipes.name: Banana Walnut Bread
recipes.description: Moist, deeply flavoured loaf made from overripe bananas and toasted walnuts — ideal for slicing all week.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175°C and line a 25 cm loaf tin with baking paper.
Mash the bananas in a large bowl and mix in the melted butter, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla extract.
Stir in the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt until just combined.
Fold in the chopped walnuts and pour into the tin.
Bake for 55 to 60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out and cool fully before slicing.

recipes.name: Coconut Chia Pudding
recipes.description: Creamy vegan chia pudding set overnight in coconut milk, topped with mango and toasted almonds.
instructions: Whisk the coconut milk, almond milk, maple syrup and vanilla extract in a bowl.
Stir in the chia seeds and whisk again after 5 minutes to break up clumps.
Cover and refrigerate overnight until thick and set.
Spoon into glasses and top with diced mango and toasted flaked almonds.

recipes.name: Full English Breakfast
recipes.description: The big weekend fry-up: sausages, bacon, fried eggs, baked beans, grilled tomatoes, mushrooms and toast.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 100°C to keep things warm. Fry the sausages in a little oil over medium heat for 12 minutes, turning, until browned.
Add the bacon to the pan and cook until crisp. Transfer both to the oven.
Halve the tomatoes and fry them cut-side down with the whole mushrooms in butter for 5 minutes.
Warm the baked beans in a small pan.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up in the remaining fat.
Toast and butter the bread and plate everything up with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Dutch Baby Pancake
recipes.description: One giant puffed oven pancake with crisp golden edges, served with lemon, powdered sugar and berries.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C with a 25 cm ovenproof skillet inside.
Blend the eggs, milk, flour, sugar, vanilla extract and salt until completely smooth.
Carefully add the butter to the hot skillet and swirl until melted and foaming.
Pour in the batter immediately and return to the oven.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes without opening the door until dramatically puffed and golden.
Squeeze over lemon juice, dust with powdered sugar and top with raspberries. Serve at once.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Hash with Eggs
recipes.description: Caramelised sweet potato, pepper and onion hash with smoked paprika, finished with eggs baked right in.
instructions: Peel and dice the sweet potatoes into 1 cm cubes.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan and fry the sweet potatoes for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until starting to brown.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper and cook 6 minutes more until tender.
Season with smoked paprika, cumin, salt and pepper.
Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook on low for 5 to 6 minutes until the whites set.
Scatter with green onions and coriander and serve with hot sauce.

newProducts.name: Baked Beans
aliases: fasole la cutie in sos de rosii
